skins.description: Over the millennia, Shen has been called many names: warlord, trespasser, conqueror. Even so, his mission to build an army for the ages seems never-ending. Seeking only the smartest and the strongest to join his ranks, he remains untroubled by emotion, casting his timeless gaze over those with hidden potential.

descriptions.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

chromas.description: This chroma was released as a bundle exclusive in 2022.

skins.description: Once half of an elite operative duo for the Shockblade order, Shen stepped away from combat after he made a mistake that nearly cost the life of his partner, Zed. Now Shen mentors young shinobi training to join their ranks – but his new charge may inspire him to take up his sword and join the fight once more.

skins.name: Three Honors Shen
skins.description: Shen is the last surviving founder of the Order of Solace. He shuttered every temple when the world fell into apathy and carelessness, disappearing into obscurity until Malzahar revived the Order. Now returned from the shadows, Shen serves as its most senior teacher, a stoic leader of integrity and grace that all can rely on.

passive.name: Ki Strike
passive.description: Every 9 seconds, Shen's next attack deals bonus damage. Each time Shen attacks, Ki Strike's cooldown is reduced.

spells.name: Vorpal Blade
spells.description: Damages target unit and life taps him, healing allies that attack the target.
spells.dynamicDescription: Shen throws a vorpal blade, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalMagicDamage_Jade@ magic damage</magicDamage> to target unit, marking them for @MarkDuration_Jade@ seconds. Allied spells and attacks against this target heal them for <healing>@TotalHealOverTimeAmount_Jade@</healing> over @HealDuration_Jade@ seconds. Killing an enemy with this Ability restores <healing>@TotalHeal_Jade@ Health</healing> instantly instead.@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@

spells.name: Feint
spells.description: Shen shields himself, absorbing incoming damage for a few seconds.
spells.dynamicDescription: Shen grants himself <shield>@TotalShieldAmount@ Shield</shield> for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. While this Ability holds, his attacks reduce <keywordMajor>Ki Strike's</keywordMajor> Cooldown by an additional 1 second.@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@

spells.name: Shadow Dash
spells.description: Shen dashes rapidly toward a target location, taunting enemy champions he encounters and dealing minor damage.
spells.dynamicDescription: Shen dashes, <status>Taunting</status> for @TauntDuration@ second(s) and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDashDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> on collision with enemy champions. <status>Taunted</status> champions are forced to attack Shen and deal @PhysDamageReductionRatio*100@% reduced physical damage. Restores <keywordMajor>@EnergyRestore@ Energy</keywordMajor> per champion affected.@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@

spells.name: Stand United
spells.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.
spells.dynamicDescription: Shen grants an allied champion <shield>@TotalShield@ Shield</shield> for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. After channeling for @ChannelDuration@ seconds, Shen Teleports to his ally's location.@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@
